blocks.text: Attacker activities are recorded as events and displayed as a graph on the Investigate page. You can evaluate the attacker's actions and how they interact with the Zscaler ITDR elements (endpoint credentials, Entra ID). You can also see additional details of these activities from ThreatParse along with timelines and view the event logs.

blocks.item: In the left-side navigation, click Investigate.
On the Investigate page, click an element on the graph. For example, click an attacker icon.
In the details pane, click View Extended Details.
ThreatParse: Attack details based on the MITRE ATT&CK framework along with a risk score in plain English. To learn more, see Viewing ThreatParse Details.
Chronology: A temporal overview and heatmap of the attacker's activities. To learn more, see Viewing Attack Chronology Details.
Event Logs: Event logs associated with an attacker activity. To learn more, see Viewing and Managing Event Logs.
